Context: 8. Reimbursement

## 8. Reimbursement  
- (a) No daily allowance shall be admissible on LTC.
- (b) Any incidental expenses and expenditure on local journeys shall not be admissible. - GID (1-B), Rule 12.
- Fares for journeys between duty station and home town, both ways, will be reimbursed by Government in full. Reservation charges are reimbursable; but telegram charges for reservation of
- (c) onward/ return journeys, etc., are not reimbursable.  
- GIDs (3) and (4), Rule 13.
